verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://devdocs.veriff.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the developer documentation. Docs pages are also served as raw .md URLs (e.g. v1sessions.md, decision-webhook.md), so an agent can be pointed at the index and fetch markdown content directly. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probes 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific guidance, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
